_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Oyo wewe Mchezaji {player_id} oyo azali na michezo ya Liar's Dice na bato {num_players}.
Mikano:
- Siku wewe ozali na wakati wa kucheza, wewe angaye:
  1) Tunga mbele mpya na wingi mwingi au uso wa juu (tangu wote mawili) kuliko mbele wa sasa; ndenge '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Ita mbele ya mwisho kwa kutunga '[Call]'.

Siku wewe ita:
  - Siku idadi ya kweli ya thamani ya uso kati ya dice zote ni chini ya mbele, mchezaji wa mwisho anapoteza die mmoja.
  - Vinginevyo, mtoa ita anapoteza die mmoja.
Mchezaji anayefikia 0 dice anatolewa. Mchezaji wa mwisho aliyesalia anashinda.

board.new_round:
Mwaka mpepa - Likolo lya malu: {dice_summary}
Malu ma mabele na yo eza: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Joueur {current_player_id} oyoka! Kiasi kinene cha kasi {face_value} ni {count}, nde ni chini ya {quantity}.
Joueur {loser_id} (meneur ya mwisho) akpwaka ndenge moko.
call.caller_loses:
Joueur {current_player_id} oyébi! Nombre ya face {face_value} ezali {count}, nde ezali >= {quantity}.
Joueur {loser_id} (moyébi) akopona die moko.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: Moto oyo abengaki te azalaki na mposa ya kopesa mbongo.
invalid_move.invalid_bid: Motango ya lifuti oyo ekoki te: {reason}
invalid_move.not_recognized: Ebandeli te ekeli kojelwa kama '[Bid: X, Y]' to '[Call]'. Ebandeli ilingi: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Motango ya sika {new_quantity} ezali moke koleka motángo oyo tozali na yango sikoyo {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: Ntalo ya sika {new_face_value} ezali moke koleka oyo ya lelo {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: Motángo ya bato oyo bazali kopesa likabo ekokani na motángo oyo ezali kopesama sikoyo.
bid_reason.face_range: Ntalo ya nkombo esengeli kozala kati na 1 mpe 6.

message.eliminated_invalid: Joueur {player_id} akopona na mvité ya makoki mabé.
